about_the_game:
《Guru Guru》 is a party brawler game supporting online multiplayer for up to 8 players. You can experience various maps in the game, and achieve the ultimate goal through confrontation or collaboration with friends – winning the match by any means necessary!

In the world of 《Guru Guru》, you'll transform into a round critter and collide with your enemies (or teammates?) to the fullest!

Everything in 《Guru Guru》 is highly "realistic". According to the Guru Guru Law, when a Guru Guru becomes too round, it's extremely difficult to stop...

Many Skills, No Burden for Guru Guru

In the Guru world, every Guru Guru is a master of skills, possessing a vast array of abilities. With these skills, Guru Gurus will be unstoppable (maybe?), invincible (possibly?). Oh, and since Guru Gurus have poor memory, every battle brings new surprises. Additionally, most skills affect both friends and foes...

Unpredictable Weather

The world of Guru Guru is as full of uncertainty as the Guru Gurus themselves. One match is sunny and calm, while the next is stormy with thunder and lightning. Remember what a great Guru Guru in history once said: "Accurate weather forecasts lead to stable Guru Guru victories." Should that be right? After all, it was a great Guru Guru!

Treasures Abound, Guru Guru

During Guru Guru's struggles, "rare treasures" occasionally appear. Clever Guru Gurus often pick up these items and then achieve... (This Guru was sent to the hospital due to item quality issues). Ahem, anyway, the Guru Guru Guide states: "You can pick up and throw anything, including other Guru Gurus." Wonder if that's true?

The Ever-Changing Guru Realm

The world of Guru Guru not only has diverse scenes but also changes constantly. Guru Gurus can have fun (or fight each other) in different arenas. However, according to a Guru Guru, the place they played yesterday was completely different when they returned today. Could it be the Eighth of the Seven Wonders?

All Gurus Love Fashion

Here, there are not only various types of Guru Gurus but also extensive wardrobes for each. Quickly put on your favorite outfit and go beat up other Guru Gurus!

Hurry up and call your friends to transform into Guru Gurus together and embark on a wonderful journey in the world of Guru Guru!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7500K / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: 《Guru Guru》 is a fun 8-player online party game with physics! You play as a round Guru Guru critter. On different maps, use skills, items, and anything you can to knock out enemies (or even teammates!) and win however you can—no rules, just chaos and fun with friends!
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
